name: 33321 · Tamarac, FL
findings: ZIP 33321 (Tamarac) has 119 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33321 (Tamarac) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33321 (Tamarac) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 58 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
